title: Design a Notification System
description: Design a multi-tenant notification platform with email, SMS and push channels, durable acceptance, per-user preferences and provider-aware retries.
functionalRequirements: Accept idempotent notification intents with recipient and channel selection
Apply user preferences, opt-outs and quiet hours before dispatch
Expose accepted, attempted, delivered or failed status without claiming exactly-once delivery
nonFunctionalRequirements: Acceptance API p95 below 200 ms within a region
Transactional notifications should reach the first provider attempt within 5 seconds at normal load
constraints: 5 million daily active recipients and 20 million notification intents/day; size for a 10x burst
Assume 1.5 selected channel attempts per intent before provider retries
Retain 7 days of 1000-byte logical intent/status records in the example capacity budget
outOfScope: Building an email or mobile push network
Marketing audience segmentation and template-editor UI
A guarantee of exactly-once delivery through every external provider

scale.assumption: Synthetic interview workload, not a claim about any named company's actual traffic.

storageEstimates.name: Seven days of logical intent/status records

stateEstimates.name: Preference records for daily active recipients

notes: The 1.5 channel multiplier is applied once: 20 million intents become 30 million baseline attempts/day.
Budget at least 20% additional attempt capacity for retries in this exercise, and discuss longer provider outages separately.
Attempt rows, template parameters, indexes and callback logs need additional storage; avoid retaining raw private content unnecessarily.
